title: Veritas FileFlow LLC
text:
Veritas FileFlow LLC

notes:
Lead source: inbound - self-serve signup + free credits used. User persona: CTO (Ana Morales) + 1 legal ops lead. Early-stage SMB legal automation product (contract summarization + search).

Discovery notes:
- 2025-02-10: initial signup, tried embeddings endpoint via playground, small test corpus (5k docs). Interested in embedding-based search + extractive summarization.
- 2025-02-11 (call ff-20250211-01): Ana on call. Key ask: audit logging for every request for eDiscovery chain-of-custody. "We need immutable logs for at least 2 years" — wants samples.
- 2025-02-12: emailed security questionnaire; attached their SOC2 checklist. Ask: KMS integration and key rotation policy.
- 2025-02-14 (call ff-20250214-02): technical deep-dive with developer (Ben). Ben tested embeddings latency; sees 150-300ms p99 target for single-doc embedding (US region). Concern about cold-starts.
- 2025-02-18: follow-up note — they preferred US-only region, flagged legal/regulatory constraint for client data.

Workload / requirements summary:
- Workloads: batch embeddings (nightly), on-demand semantic search for lawyers, short summarization for docs (avg 1.2k tokens). Occasional chatty Q&A for client intake.
- Latency targets: embeddings <300ms p99 per request; summarization return within 800ms for 1k tokens (acceptable up to 1.5s).
- Throughput: initial 10k-50k embeddings/month; projected 100k tokens/month in 3 months. Cost-sensitive — prefers predictable per-token pricing.
- Model preferences: open models OK if verified perf; wants fallback routing if primary model unavailable.

Security / compliance specifics raised:
- Immutable audit logs + user attribution (SSO identity mapping).
- Retention controls: must be able to set 2yr retention for logs, and option to disable data retention for content (PII concerns).
- KMS/HSM for key management and customer-managed keys for embeddings at-rest.
- Data residency: US-only region requirement for production.

Commercial / next steps:
- They are a self-serve org today but willing to sign small reserved commit if pricing/controls align.
- Action items: Jordan to send hosted API onboarding doc + security FAQ (done 2025-02-18). Maya to prepare short demo focused on audit logs + KMS flows and sample audit output. Provide example log schema and retention options.
- Requested artifacts: sample audit log export, SOC2 attestation, pricing estimate for 100k tokens/month + embedding storage.

Notes/tone: concise, pragmatic team. More worried about compliance than raw latency; cost is important but they'd trade some cost for strong auditability. Prefers minimal friction — "we want to keep using hosted API if residency + audit answers are solid."

next_step:
Send hosted API onboarding + security FAQ; propose 30m walkthrough (Maya/Jordan) week of 2025-02-24

blockers:
audit log retention window (legal requirements)
US-only data residency confirmation
pricing for 100k tokens/month with embedding storage
